title: ceratostylis pleurothallis

The health benefits of Ceratostylis pleurothallis include its potential to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing due to its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are thought to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that have antimicrobial and antioxidant effects.
